agent.description: The name of the local agent to follow up with. One of: auto-human, bugfixer, deep-researcher, e2e-tester, expert, explore, general, iterator, planner, reviewer

agent_id.description: The exact durable subagent id a background dispatch returned. Mutually exclusive with `agent` — pass exactly one of the two.

message.description: The follow-up message for the agent.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the reply before giving up (the message stays delivered; the reply arrives later as a settlement or agent message). Omit to wait until the conversation moves on.
